votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 9 of 2021 declaring between April 8, 2021 and May 8, 2021 as days to Sound the Alarm to help educate and protect residents of our community against home fires
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing a period to raise awareness about home fire safety in partnership with the American Red Cross Sound the Alarm program.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer Item B-1 to a future consent agenda for action
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the Utah Railroad Safety Grant application for safety improvements to the railroad crossing at 4900 West 700 South and refers it to a future consent agenda for formal action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer the item (Budget Amendment No. 7 for Fiscal Year 2020-21) to a future date for action
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed FY 2020-21 Budget Amendment No. 7, which includes rental assistance funding, NLC Conference hosting funds, and an outdoor business activity pilot program, and defers action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer the item (One-year Action Plan for Community Development Block Grant & Other Federal Grants for FY 2021-22) to a future date for action
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the FY 2021-22 Annual Action Plan covering CDBG, HOME, ESG, and HOPWA federal grant funding and defers adoption to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 6 of 2021 amending the final budget for the Library Budget of Salt Lake City for Fiscal Year 2020-2021
votes.description: Adopts a budget amendment for the Library Fund for FY 2020-21, including funding for the Library's Master Facilities Plan, digital access grants, earthquake repairs, and branch renovations.

votes.motion: Ratify the motion of the determination for the Council to continue meeting remotely and without an anchor location under HB5002
votes.description: Formally ratifies the Chair's determination that the City Council will continue to hold electronic meetings without a physical anchor location as permitted under HB5002.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 7 of 2021 amending Chapter 2.30 of Salt Lake City Code, pertaining to the Percent for Art
votes.description: Amends the Percent for Art ordinance to increase the annual CIP funding minimum for public art from 1% to 1.5%, creates a public art maintenance fund, and adjusts the Art Design Board's powers and membership limits.
Sets public hearing dates of May 18, 2021 for the Learned Alley Vacation and Fern Subdivision Alley Vacation ordinances, approving both consent items together.
